from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityEnrollmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of admission and enrollment data for one university from one document."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The academic period covered by the data, e.g., 'Fall 2021'")
    admitted_first_year_degree_seeking_count: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year degree-seeking students admitted")
    enrolled_first_year_degree_seeking_count: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year degree-seeking students enrolled")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_enrollment_records: list[UniversityEnrollmentRecord]
